signatures.description: AttributeGet returns selected attributes from an HTML root.

return.description: Existing attribute values keyed by name.

signatures.description: AttributeQuery returns selected attributes from the first matching element.

return.description: Existing attribute values keyed by name.

signatures.description: AttributeRemove removes attributes from an HTML root.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Attribute value when a name is supplied.

signatures.description: AttributeSet sets one or more attributes on an HTML root.
BaseURL returns the effective base URL of a page or document.
Blur removes focus from an HTML root or selected element.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Click count for a selected element.

signatures.description: Click clicks an HTML root or selected element.

return.description: Whether the target was found and clicked.

signatures.description: ClickAll clicks every element matching a selector.

return.description: Whether at least one element was found and clicked.

parameters.name: cookiesOrNames
parameters.description: Cookie values or cookie names to delete.

signatures.description: CookieDel deletes cookies from a page.
CookieGet returns a named page cookie when present.
CookieSet sets cookies on a page.

Open loads an HTML page from a URL.

Options may select a driver, timeout, user agent, cookie reuse, cookies,
headers, ignored resources or status codes, viewport, source charset, and an
initScript.
For CDP, beforeDocument uses the browser's new-document
mechanism; same-target frames inherit it subject to browser target limits.
afterNavigation runs after Ferret's controlled navigation reaches main-frame
readiness.
PageExists reports whether a URL returns a successful HTTP response.

return.description: Whether the URL returned a successful response.

signatures.description: Download downloads a resource from a URL.
Element returns the first element matching a selector.
Elements returns all elements matching a selector.
ElementsCount returns the number of elements matching a selector.
ElementExists reports whether an element matches a selector.
Focus focuses an HTML root or selected element.

parameters.name: expression
parameters.description: Regular expression for the property value.

signatures.description: Frames returns page frames whose property matches a regular expression.
Hover moves the mouse over an HTML root or selected element.
GetInnerHTML returns HTML from a root or selected element.

return.description: Inner HTML, or an empty string when no element matches.

signatures.description: GetInnerHTMLAll returns HTML from every matching element.

return.description: Inner HTML values in match order.

parameters.name: html
parameters.description: HTML content when a selector is supplied.

signatures.description: SetInnerHTML sets HTML on a root or selected element.
GetInnerText returns text from a root or selected element.

return.description: Inner text, or an empty string when no element matches.

signatures.description: GetInnerTextAll returns text from every matching element.

return.description: Inner text values in match order.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Text content when a selector is supplied.

signatures.description: SetInnerText sets text on a root or selected element.
Input types a value into an HTML root or selected input element.

return.description: Whether the target was found and received input.

signatures.description: InputClear clears an HTML root or selected input element.

return.description: Whether the target was found and cleared.

signatures.description: IsHTMLDocument reports whether a value is an HTML document.

return.description: Whether the value is an HTMLDocument.

signatures.description: IsHTMLElement reports whether a value is an HTML element.

return.description: Whether the value is an HTMLElement.

signatures.description: MouseMoveXY moves the mouse to absolute viewport coordinates.
Navigate loads a URL in a page and waits for navigation to finish.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of history entries to skip.

signatures.description: NavigateBack moves backward through page history.

return.description: Whether history existed and navigation succeeded.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of history entries to skip.

signatures.description: NavigateForward moves forward through page history.

return.description: Whether history existed and navigation succeeded.

signatures.description:
Pagination returns an iterator that advances by clicking a selector.

The first iteration yields the current page without clicking.

Parse loads an HTML page from string or binary content.

Options may select a driver, cookie reuse, cookies, headers, and viewport.

PDF renders a page or URL as a PDF document.

Options control orientation, headers and footers, background graphics, scale,
paper size, margins, page ranges, templates, and CSS page-size preference.
Press sends keyboard input to an HTML root.

return.description: True when the keys are sent.

signatures.description: PressSelector sends keyboard input to a selected element.

return.description: True when the keys are sent.

signatures.description: ResolveURL resolves a URL against a page or document's effective base URL.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Capture bounds, format, and quality options.

signatures.description:
Screenshot captures a screenshot of a page or URL.

The format is JPEG or PNG; quality applies only to JPEG.
ScrollXY scrolls a page or document to absolute coordinates.
ScrollBottom scrolls a page or document to the bottom.
ScrollInto scrolls an HTML root or selected element into view.
ScrollTop scrolls a page or document to the top.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: Values when a selector is supplied.

signatures.description: Select selects values in a select element.
StyleGet returns selected style values from an element.

return.description: Existing style values keyed by name.

signatures.description: StyleRemove removes style values from an element.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Style value when a name is supplied.

signatures.description: StyleSet sets one or more style values on an element.
Unhover moves the mouse outside an HTML root or selected element.

return.description: Whether the mouse was moved away.

signatures.description: URL returns the current URL of a page or document.
WaitAttribute waits for an attribute value to appear.

return.description: True when the expected state is observed.

signatures.description: WaitAttributeAll waits for an attribute value on all matching elements.

return.description: True when the expected state is observed on every match.

signatures.description: WaitClass waits for a class to appear.
WaitClassAll waits for a class on all matching elements.

return.description: True when the class appears on every match.

signatures.description: WaitElement waits for an element to appear.

WaitNavigation waits for page or frame navigation.

Navigation options may specify timeout, target URL, and frame.
WaitNoAttribute waits for an attribute value to disappear.

return.description: True when the expected state is observed.

signatures.description: WaitNoAttributeAll waits for an attribute value to disappear from all matching elements.

return.description: True when the expected state is observed on every match.

signatures.description: WaitNoClass waits for a class to disappear.
WaitNoClassAll waits for a class to disappear from all matching elements.

return.description: True when the class disappears from every match.

signatures.description: WaitNoElement waits for an element to disappear.
WaitNoStyle waits for a style value to disappear.

return.description: True when the expected state is observed.

signatures.description: WaitNoStyleAll waits for a style value to disappear from all matching elements.

return.description: True when the expected state is observed on every match.

signatures.description: WaitStyle waits for a style value to appear.

return.description: True when the expected state is observed.

signatures.description: WaitStyleAll waits for a style value on all matching elements.

return.description: True when the expected state is observed on every match.
